headline: Turn banked shrine shards into a visible next offering instead of a dead-end receipt.

items.title: Shrine offering intent contract
items.why: The banked Sunstone path now has real economy semantics, but the next verb is still implicit. A deterministic offering-intent contract turns a banked shard into an actionable route target without adding browser token cost or backend assumptions.
items.recipe: Add a pure `dailyRiteOfferingIntent` helper that derives a sanitized zero-token offering intent from banked shrine bargains, attach it to shrine bargain receipts, and keep spend/oath postures intentionally non-offering.

items.title: Visible shrine offering status
items.why: Players should immediately know when the Daily Rite created a shard they can carry to a grave or shrine. The active Daily Rite panel and public chronicle digest should expose that next action in the same zero-token contract family as route choices and shrine bargains.
items.recipe: Normalize offering intent fields in `getDailyRiteStatusContract`, render concise offering copy in `DailyRiteStatus`, and include offering-intent previews in the public shrine bargain digest.

items.title: Shrine offering zero-token tests
items.why: Offering intent feeds UI and public JSON, so it must be bounded, sanitized, and deterministic before browser-level coverage exists. Tests should prove only banked bargains create offering targets, public exports stay token-free, and hostile labels cannot leak markup.
items.recipe: Extend the Daily Rite system tests for bank/spend/oath offering intent behavior, status-contract sanitization, public `daily_rite_shrine_bargains` export shape, and full local validation.

executionLog.evidence: Added `src/game/dailyRiteOfferingIntent.js`; banked shrine bargains now attach a sanitized zero-token offering intent targeted at the Living Map, while spend/oath postures intentionally produce no offering intent.
Daily Rite status contracts normalize `offering_intent`, `DailyRiteStatus` renders offering-opened copy, and public shrine bargain digests include a zero-token offering-intent preview.
`npm test` passed 64/64, `npm run smoke` passed, and `npm run build` passed after adding bank/spend/oath offering-intent assertions and public export checks.
